retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s soul music aesthetic featuring a close-up portrait framed by out-of-focus foreground elements and high-contrast swash typography.
triggerTerms: analog film portrait with foreground bokeh

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, analog-style portrait of a man partially obscured by a blurred, warm-toned foreground element, set against a textured, stone-like background with prominent decorative typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by a vertical blurred foreground element on the left
High-contrast relationship between dark hair/skin and pale background texture
Typographic weight balanced against the visual weight of the subject's head
Warm, earthy color palette with a single cool-toned accent in the text
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and analog texture
Decorative swash capitals for the primary name
Asymmetric composition with significant negative space in the upper right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower-left to center-left, rendered in a medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large decorative 'J' and 'S' in the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the blurred foreground on the left, to the subject's face, then upward to the primary typography, and finally to the tracklist on the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the textured wall behind the subject and the blurred foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sepia tones in the foreground and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale grey stone textures in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue for the secondary script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extravagant swash terminals on capital letters
Tight letter spacing (kerning) with some overlaps
Thick-to-thin stroke modulation typical of 1970s display faces
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'J' and 'S' feature deep, circular loops
Lower-case 'i' dot is integrated into the swash of the preceding letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold black decorative serif paired with a fluid blue italic script and a secondary block of small sans-serif metadata.
graphicDevices: Ellipsis used as a lead-in to the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s swash aesthetic and heavy weight.
Provides the correct vintage serif structure and period feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a soulful expression, shot on 35mm film with heavy grain. Place a large, out-of-focus warm-toned vertical object in the left foreground. The background should be a pale, textured stone wall with natural cracks and aging.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large display name in the upper right using a bold swash serif font in black. Directly beneath, add a subtitle in a blue italic script starting with an ellipsis. Add a block of small, justified sans-serif text in the upper left.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground element sufficiently blurred?
Does the typography feature prominent swashes?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the color palette limited to earth tones and one blue accent?

avoid: Perfectly sharp focus across the frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the 'ink bleed' effect on the typography
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the subject's features
Confirm the blue accent provides enough contrast against the stone background
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Portrait + Foreground Bokeh + 70s Swash Typography + Textured Background
